title: Two linear subspaces that agree on a ball about a common point are equal
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let Q₁ and Q₂ be linear subspaces of ℝ^P, let x ∈ Q₁ and t > 0. If Q₁ ∩ B_t(x) = Q₂ ∩ B_t(x), where B_t(x) is the open ball of radius t about x, then Q₁ = Q₂.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q₁ Q₂ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), x ∈ Q₁ → 0 < t → (Q₁ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x t = (Q₂ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x t → Q₁ = Q₂
